name: file-upload
title: File upload
description: Choose files by browsing or dropping them, and see what is selected.
a11y: A native file input stays focusable and operable by keyboard; the drop zone is a label for it.
Selected files are listed as text with a Remove button each; changes are announced via a polite status.
Dragging is an extra, never the only way.

props.name: label
props.description: The visible prompt, for example "Drop files here or choose".

props.name: onFilesChange
props.description: Called with the full current list whenever it changes.

usage: import {FileUpload} from '@monoline/react';
